requirements.requirement: Run the inventory web application on node2, listening on port 8080.
requirements.summary: Node2 directly showed inventory.service enabled and active, a listener on 0.0.0.0:8080, HTTP 200 health responses identifying node2, and inventory data. The same service, listener, health response, and data recovered after restart.

requirements.requirement: Run the inventory web application on node3, listening on port 8080.
requirements.summary: Node3 directly showed inventory.service enabled and active, a listener on 0.0.0.0:8080, HTTP 200 health responses identifying node3, and inventory data. The same service, listener, health response, and data recovered after restart.

requirements.requirement: Configure node1 to accept HTTP on port 80 and load-balance requests across node2 and node3.
requirements.summary: Node1 directly showed nginx active and listening on port 80, with both required backend addresses in its effective configuration. Repeated end-to-end requests returned successful inventory health responses from both node2 and node3, including after all node restarts.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct end-to-end evidence. Both backend applications serve inventory data on port 8080, node1 serves on port 80 and demonstrably distributes requests to both backends, and the complete provider-wide restart protocol confirms persistence and recovery on all three nodes.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Application files and hardened systemd services on node2 and node3, nginx installation and configuration on node1, and service enablement were causally necessary for the requested deployment. The three reboot actions were required bounded evidence collection for the provider-wide restart protocol. Final snapshots show no failed services, healthy package state, and only the task-required listeners. Restart evidence is complete for every node: each has a healthy pre-restart state, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered service/data participation; fixed lifecycle boot identities independently agree with the executor observations.
